text.zh-CN: 产后出血是分娩后失血过多，可迅速影响血液循环。正常产后恶露是逐渐减少的阴道排出物，不能把突然大量出血一概当作正常恶露。
text.en: Postpartum hemorrhage is excessive bleeding after childbirth that can rapidly impair circulation. Normal lochia, the postpartum vaginal discharge, should gradually diminish; sudden heavy bleeding should not be assumed normal.

text.en: WHO 2025 recommends first-response treatment within 24 hours after birth at measured loss of 500 mL, or 300 mL with abnormal circulatory signs, whichever occurs first.

text.en: Postoperative drops have different roles: antibiotics help prevent infection, while anti-inflammatory medicines reduce inflammation. The clinician may select a corticosteroid, such as dexamethasone, or a combination containing both a steroid and an antibiotic. The surgical team sets the choice and course.

text.zh-CN: 术后按本人的出院单使用止痛药。给儿童使用对乙酰氨基酚（也叫扑热息痛）等药时，要核对本品适用的年龄、体重和标签用量；不能用成人用量或别人的处方推算。过量使用，或重复服用含有对乙酰氨基酚的不同药品，可能使总量超标并损伤肝脏。不知道该给多少时，先问医生或药师。
text.en: Use pain medicine according to your own discharge instructions. For children taking medicines such as acetaminophen (paracetamol), check the product's age, weight and dose instructions instead of estimating from an adult dose or another person's prescription. Taking too much, including combining different products that contain acetaminophen, can exceed the safe total and damage the liver. Ask a doctor or pharmacist if the amount is unclear.

supports.assessment: Child after torsion repair: own bottle dose and own prescribed dose/frequency.
Adult/older patient postoperative package dose instructions.

supports.locator: How much to give (paracetamol row); Medicine safety; Common questions
supports.assessment: Reopened 2026-09-30: child weight/product instructions and checking other medicines for paracetamol; Medicine safety explicitly states overdose causes liver and kidney damage. Only liver harm added; no dosage, intervals, or wait-48-hours advice transferred.

supports.locator: Opening safety paragraphs; Acetaminophen Is in Many Products; Rely on Health Care Experts
supports.assessment: Reopened 2026-09-30: excessive total acetaminophen, including combination products, can cause serious liver damage; read ingredient labels and child age/weight directions, do not guess. Other-person prescription caution remains a patient-specific safety synthesis. No adult daily limit transferred.

text.zh-CN: 若检查和病情判断提示附睾或睾丸存在细菌感染，医生会考虑抗生素；非细菌原因的处理不同。这不能替代疑似扭转的急诊手术评估，止痛后缓解也不应推迟就医。
text.en: If examination, tests and clinical assessment suggest a bacterial infection of the epididymis or testicle, clinicians consider antibiotics; nonbacterial causes require different management. This does not replace emergency surgical assessment for suspected torsion, even if pain relief helps.

supports.locator: Investigations: suspected epididymo-orchitis; Treatment: testicular torsion and suspected epididymo-orchitis
supports.assessment: Reopened 2026-09-30: distinguishes bacterial likelihood and viral causes, uses clinician-directed antibiotics for suspected epididymo-orchitis, and urgent surgical assessment when torsion cannot be excluded. Does not itself state the EAU prepubertal no-routine-antibiotics rule; author wording allows clinical suspicion without waiting for culture.

Reopened 2026-09-30: prepubertal epididymitis usually unclear/nonbacterial and self-limiting; antibiotics generally not indicated without bacterial evidence. Confirmed torsion needs surgery and relief after manual detorsion does not remove that need. Supports bacterial indication and different nonbacterial management, not blanket anti-infective treatment of every inflammation.

independence.rationale: Author-reading inventory only. Section and paragraph-specific independence pending; shared institutional pages grouped together.

dispute.resolution: Author notes population/clinical-suspicion difference: EAU 8.3.1 addresses chiefly prepubertal epididymitis and bacterial evidence; RCH treatment table covers suspected epididymo-orchitis, including unwell young infants. Text asks clinicians to judge bacterial infection and does not require waiting for culture or prescribe antibiotics. Independent reconciliation remains pending.

unresolved_questions: medications-3: child product/weight-label checks now have RCH and FDA direct support. Do not copy another person's prescription remains practical synthesis from patient-specific instructions, not a verbatim two-source rule. Independent reviewer must adjudicate that action boundary.

text.zh-CN: 美国FDA已批准替尔泊肽用于合并肥胖的中重度OSA成人，并配合降低能量摄入和增加活动。它通过体重相关机制改善病情；这项美国适应证不能自动当成其他国家的批准。
text.en: The US FDA approved tirzepatide for adults with obesity and moderate-to-severe OSA, alongside reduced calorie intake and more activity. Improvement is linked to weight reduction; the US indication does not establish approval elsewhere.

text.zh-CN: 替尔泊肽常见不适包括恶心、呕吐、腹泻或便秘；用药前需讨论胰腺、胆囊、肾脏病史及合用降糖药。美国资料规定，有个人或家族髓样甲状腺癌（一种来自特定甲状腺细胞的癌症）病史，或有2型多发性内分泌肿瘤综合征（MEN2，一种遗传性内分泌肿瘤病）者不能使用。
text.en: Tirzepatide may cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or constipation. Review pancreatic, gallbladder and kidney history and other glucose-lowering medicines beforehand. US information contraindicates use with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid cancer (a cancer of specific thyroid cells) or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN2, an inherited endocrine tumor disorder).

text.zh-CN: 安眠药和镇静止痛药可能影响夜间呼吸。把OSA告诉开药和麻醉团队，按其安排使用或调整；不要自行加量来压住夜间醒来。
text.en: Sleeping medicines and sedating pain medicines can affect breathing. Tell prescribing and anesthesia teams about OSA and follow their plan rather than increasing doses to suppress awakenings.

text.zh-CN: 正在使用替尔泊肽时，手术或深镇静检查前还要主动报出药名。药物会让胃排空变慢，麻醉时胃内容物进入肺部的风险可能增加；由麻醉和开药团队安排用药及饮食，不自行套用停药天数。
text.en: If taking tirzepatide, name the medicine before surgery or deep sedation. Slower stomach emptying can increase the risk of stomach contents entering the lungs during anesthesia; the anesthesia and prescribing teams should plan medication and food instructions rather than a self-chosen stopping interval.

text.zh-CN: 妊娠期不要使用替尔泊肽；用药中发现怀孕，应停药并联系开药医生。准备怀孕时，提前讨论停药和避孕安排，不自行套用其他减重药的停药时间。
text.en: Do not use tirzepatide during pregnancy. If pregnancy is recognized, stop it and contact the prescriber. Discuss medication and contraception plans before trying to conceive; stopping intervals differ between medicines.

text.zh-CN: 口服避孕药可能受替尔泊肽影响而降低效果。开始用药后4周、每次增加剂量后4周，需加用避孕套等屏障避孕，或与医生商定改用非口服避孕方式；更换方式时确认何时开始有效。
text.en: Tirzepatide can reduce oral contraceptive effectiveness. For 4 weeks after starting and 4 weeks after each dose increase, add a barrier such as condoms or arrange non-oral contraception. Check when a changed method becomes effective.

text.zh-CN: 哺乳期建议存在地区差异：美国2026年标签报告，11名哺乳者单次用药后乳汁中药物很少或未检出，但缺少婴儿结局及乳量影响资料，需由医生共同权衡；英国MHRA仍建议哺乳期不用。开始或继续用药前说明正在哺乳，并按所在地现行建议讨论。
text.en: Breastfeeding advice differs: the 2026 US label reports low or undetectable milk levels after one dose in 11 lactating adults, but no infant-outcome or milk-production data, and calls for weighing benefits and risks. UK MHRA advises against use while breastfeeding. Discuss local guidance before starting or continuing.

supports.assessment: US label supports11-person single-dose milk data, absent infant/production evidence and maternal/infant benefit-risk consideration. This does not establish safety for long-term exposure.

UK regulator explicitly advises no use during breastfeeding because safety data are insufficient; this differs from the newer US label and is shown as regional advice, not averaged into a universal instruction.

independence.rationale: Distinct named institutional authors are retained; multiple NIH pages count as one origin. FDA approval and AASM/NHLBI discussion share trial and regulatory evidence. DailyMed hosts the manufacturer label rather than a new NIH review; FDA/label facts share regulatory evidence. MHRA is independently authored regulatory advice with overlapping product evidence.

dispute.resolution: US tirzepatide indication is explicitly regional; no China/UK approval inferred. UK diagnostic and driving pathways labeled. No universal adult AHI cutoff applied to children. Reproductive safety: US August2026 label requires pregnancy discontinuation and US/UK advice agrees on4-week oral-contraception precautions. US label describes low/undetectable single-dose milk exposure with no infant outcomes and individualized benefit-risk consideration; UK February2026 MHRA advice remains no breastfeeding use. Regional advice is explicitly retained; no global lactation ban or safety assurance inferred.

text.zh-CN: 短期咳嗽没有危险表现且逐渐改善，可先休息、饮水。出现气短、胸痛、咯血或明显恶化时，按危险信号重新评估。咳嗽持续并妨碍睡眠、上学或工作，也应联系医生。
text.en: A short, improving cough without warning signs may initially need rest and fluids. Breathlessness, chest pain, blood or marked deterioration warrants reassessment using the warning-sign advice. Contact a clinician if ongoing cough disrupts sleep, school or work.

supports.assessment: Rest/fluids and warning symptoms.

text.en: NHS advice recommends review for cough over 3 weeks; CDC advice for acute bronchitis in otherwise healthy people uses symptoms over 3 weeks too. Unexplained weight loss, impaired immunity or repeated episodes warrant earlier contact.

supports.assessment: Over 3 weeks, weight loss, weakened immunity.

text.en: Runny nose, sore throat and sick contacts suggest infection; sneezing after pollen exposure suggests allergy; wheeze or activity-related episodes may involve asthma. Each clue needs the surrounding history.

text.en: Reflux or nasal drainage can explain persistent cough. Sudden breathlessness with chest pain may reflect pulmonary embolism or a collapsed lung; pneumonia may cause fever and breathing changes. Serious causes need assessment.

text.en: An uncomplicated viral illness may need rest and fluids. Asthma-related cough may need inhaled therapy for airway inflammation or narrowing. Nasal allergy, reflux and medicine-related cough need their own management.

text.zh-CN: 饮水帮助维持水分。蜂蜜可用于1岁及以上人群的急性咳嗽，但效果证据有限；不喂给未满1岁婴儿，也不要给幼儿烫饮。
text.en: Fluids support hydration. Honey may help acute cough from age 1, with limited benefit evidence; do not give it to younger babies or give young children scalding drinks.

supports.assessment: Limited benefit, under-1 restriction and no hot drinks for small children.

text.zh-CN: 成人经评估发现反流参与咳嗽后，可观察咖啡、酒精、高脂或辛辣食物是否诱发自己的反流症状，并讨论减少相关食物和调整晚餐时间。成人反流资料不直接用于儿童饮食；仅凭咳嗽也不要求人人禁食同一清单。
text.en: After assessment finds reflux contributing to an adult’s cough, check whether coffee, alcohol, fatty or spicy foods trigger that person’s reflux symptoms and discuss targeted changes and evening meal timing. Adult reflux advice does not directly determine a child’s diet, and cough alone does not justify identical food bans for everyone.

supports.assessment: Adult individual reflux triggers and evening timing.
Independent adult selective trigger/meal advice.

text.zh-CN: 记下开始日期、睡眠影响、痰和血、发热、气短、烟尘接触及用药。就诊时带上记录，便于区分感染、过敏和其他原因。
text.en: Record onset, sleep disruption, mucus or blood, fever, breathlessness, smoke exposure and medicines. Bring this information to distinguish infection, allergy and other causes.

text.zh-CN: 休息，减少烟草和刺激性空气接触；使用加湿器时保持清洁。新出现胸痛、呼吸困难或血痰，停止只做家庭护理；咯血超过少量血丝、出血持续不停或咯血伴气短、胸部或上背痛时，按危险信号立即急救。
text.en: Rest, reduce smoke or irritant exposure and keep any humidifier clean. New chest pain, breathing difficulty or blood means moving beyond home care. More than a few blood streaks, bleeding that will not stop, or blood with breathlessness or chest/upper-back pain requires the immediate action described under warning signs.

supports.assessment: Rest/clean humidifier.
Humidifier cleaning and smoke avoidance.
Independent cleaning and irritant advice.
Blood with cardiopulmonary signs: emergency.
Persistent/large bleeding emergency.
Blood with chest pain or breathlessness: ambulance.

text.zh-CN: 小婴儿咳嗽应更早联系医疗人员。不足3个月且体温达到38℃时，美国CDC建议立即联系医务人员，英国NHS也要求紧急咨询；若同时呼吸困难或反应异常，按危险信号急救。儿童治疗不是把成人方案简单缩小剂量。
text.en: Contact a clinician earlier for a young infant with cough. For a child under 3 months with a temperature of 38°C or more, CDC advises immediate clinician contact and NHS advises urgent consultation. Breathing difficulty or abnormal responsiveness also requires the emergency warning-sign pathway. Pediatric care is not an adult regimen with a smaller dose.

supports.assessment: Under-3-month infant with cough: immediate contact.
Under 3 months plus at least 38C: immediate contact.
Same fever criterion; breathing/response warnings escalate.

text.en: Older people with significant heart, lung or kidney disease, or people receiving chemotherapy or immune suppression, should not simply apply bronchitis self-care advice for otherwise healthy people. Pregnancy requires checking medicine suitability.

text.zh-CN: 英国NHS和NICE说明普通急性咳嗽可持续3至4周。这不是出现危险信号后继续等待的理由；超过3周仍咳嗽可安排评估。
text.en: NHS and NICE describe a usual acute-cough course of up to 3–4 weeks. This does not justify waiting through warning signs; ongoing cough beyond 3 weeks warrants assessment.

text.zh-CN: 治疗后仍反复、加重或妨碍睡眠与生活，复诊时重新核对病因、用药和暴露。持续咳嗽可能需要呼吸专科评估，不应一轮轮重复同样的感冒药。
text.en: Recurrent, worsening or disruptive cough after treatment warrants review of the cause, medicines and exposures. Persistent cough may need respiratory assessment rather than repeated courses of the same cold remedies.

supports.assessment: Ongoing burden and nonresponse discussion.
Cause/medicine/exposure review, possible specialist.

text.en: Pneumonia, a collapsed lung and heart failure have their own risks; ordinary cough does not inevitably progress to them. New breathlessness, chest pain or blood needs reassessment.

text.zh-CN: 并发问题属于具体病因，不应把所有严重腹部疾病都说成“腹痛的并发症”。
text.en: Complications belong to the underlying condition; serious abdominal diseases are not all complications of the symptom itself.

text.zh-CN: 呕吐和腹泻会丢失水分和盐类，造成脱水，儿童和老人尤其容易受影响；不能喝水或尿少提示需要重新评估补液。
text.en: Vomiting and diarrhea lose water and salts and can cause dehydration, particularly in children and older people. Inability to drink or reduced urine needs reassessment of fluid replacement.

text.zh-CN: 肠道堵塞、阑尾炎等需要及时处理的原因，可能使病情继续恶化，因此持续或加重的腹痛需要复评；是否存在这些病变由检查判断，不凭疼痛程度排除。
text.en: Time-sensitive causes such as bowel obstruction or appendicitis can worsen, making persistent or increasing pain a reason for reassessment. Examination determines whether they are present; pain intensity alone does not exclude them.

text.zh-CN: 预防围绕已经确定的病因；日常习惯不能消除全部腹痛风险。
text.en: Prevention targets an established cause; daily habits cannot remove every risk of abdominal pain.

text.zh-CN: 容易便秘者可采用规律活动、逐渐增加纤维和合适的饮水，帮助排便；不是在疑似堵塞时突然大量吃纤维。
text.en: For constipation tendency, regular activity, gradually added fiber and suitable fluids support bowel function; suspected obstruction is a different situation requiring assessment.

text.zh-CN: 明确食物不耐受或其他消化疾病后，遵循对应饮食和随访方案；复发时核对诱因及用药。新出现的危险信号仍按本次症状处理，不因以前有过类似疼痛而忽略。
text.en: After a food intolerance or digestive condition is identified, follow its diet and review plan and reassess triggers or medicines when symptoms return. New warning signs need assessment even after similar previous episodes.
